name: Proof of Deed
summary: Mountaineer Pebblebitty sends you to bring Margol’s Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge. It is a trophy from the Searing Gorge, where Margol the Rager troubled archaeologists.

sections.title: At the Museum
sections.body: Curator Thorius greets you in Ironforge with an offer to tour the museum. When you show him Margol’s Gigantic Horn, he recognizes it as belonging to Margol the Rager. The horn recalls an enemy known to archaeologists who entered the Searing Gorge.

faq.answer: Margol the Rager is known as a bane to archaeologists who set foot in the Searing Gorge.
Curator Thorius recognizes Margol’s Gigantic Horn as the horn of Margol the Rager.

faq.q: Where do I take Margol’s Gigantic Horn?
faq.answer: You take Margol’s Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge.
Margol troubled archaeologists who set foot in the Searing Gorge.
